purpose: Teach: （株）/小生/亭/竹中/ニッポン放送/世田谷/キャピタル/人組

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 四半期報告、小生の名で送る前に、書類を確認させてくれ。
lines.en: Before I send the quarterly report under my name, let me review the documents.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. Methodical pace without rush. The quiet expectation of compliance with no need to raise the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。表紙、サムライ亭での懇親会写真、入れています。
lines.en: Yes. The cover includes a photo from the Samurai-tei reception.
lines.style: Steady, attentive delivery. No inflection of opinion — just confirmation of task completion. Slight forward lean showing readiness for the next instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 竹中代議士のコメント、ニッポン放送で流れた音源も、参照しろ。
lines.en: Also reference MP Takenaka's comment and the Nippon Hoso audio clip.
lines.style: Crisp directive. Light emphasis on each item. No negotiation in the tone — ordering, not suggesting. Brief pause between elements for clarity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本社（株）の世田谷オフィス、案内文に明記しました。
lines.en: The Setagaya office address is clearly noted in the invitation.
lines.style: Calm confirmation. Even delivery showing the task is done without drama. Slight nod embedded in the voice — moving forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: キャピタル経由の資金、3人組の役員でしっかり管理を。
lines.en: Funds routed through Capital — the three-officer team needs to keep a tight grip on the management of it.
lines.style: Firm, concluding weight. Deliberate pacing on the final instruction. Embedded warning without harshness. The tone of someone closing a door, not opening one.
